title: "O11 Develop quality assessment instruments"
link-citations: true
---

Terminology: risk-of-bias tools; critical appraisal tools

## Definition
These studies aim to develop instruments that help health researchers or other interest-holders assess methodological rigor, trustworthiness, or other quality-related constructs in a standardized way. Such instruments typically use multiple signaling questions with predefined response options, sometimes combined into a summary judgment.

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples
[Consensus studies](../approaches/8consensus.qmd): discussion-based consensus on quality assessment tool for subgroup analyses.[@Schandelmaier2020development]

[Reliability and agreement studies](../approaches/4reliability.qmd): reliability of risk of bias tools for observational studies.[@Kalaycioglu2023inter-rater]

[Reviews of applied or planned methods](../approaches/9review-applied.qmd): review practice of assessing risk of bias due to missing evidence in systematic reviews to inform risk-of-bias tool.[@Page2023rob-me]

[Scoping reviews of methods research](../approaches/11scoping-review.qmd): review of existing instruments informed the development of the AMSTAR2 instrument for assessing the quality of systematic reviews.[@Shea2017amstar]
